business: ClaimMatch (lawsuitai.org): free-during-beta assistant for finding open US class-action settlements and filing yourself on the official site. Assisted filing and any recovery fee are not live.
target: Hypothesis, not observed customers: US adults 25-55 who use mainstream banks, retailers, telecoms and apps, and have heard of settlement checks but rarely file

segments.name: Data-breach victim searching a named breach (hypothesis)

behaviours.name: Skeptic of 'free money' sites
behaviours.how: Assumes settlement sites are scams until proven otherwise.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Looks for easy claims. Hypothesis only — the product does not tell people to file ineligible or no-proof claims.

behaviours.name: Procrastinator
behaviours.how: Means to file, misses the deadline.

behaviours.name: Privacy-cautious
behaviours.how: Won't give an address or phone to a startup.

behaviours.name: Search-driven one-timer
behaviours.how: Arrives from Google for one settlement and leaves.

objections: Is this a scam or a data grab?
If it's free during beta, what's the catch later?
The payouts are like $10, not worth it
I don't want a startup storing my identity details
How do you even know I qualify?

you saw a TikTok about a no-proof settlement
